$comment: Commits whose work must remain reachable from main.
regressions in one day produced this file. The first two were stale
bundles, now covered by the provenance and feature-marker gates. The
third was different: a commit stopped being an ancestor of main because
history was rewritten over it, and because its source, its imports AND
its registry entry all vanished together, the resulting main was
internally consistent and every content-level guard passed.
Guarding content is not enough when commits can silently stop existing.
ADD an entry after landing work you cannot afford to lose.
REMOVE one only as a deliberate, explained act in the same commit that

commits.note: guards: provenance stamp, protected-features registry, generic source guard
throwables: true alpha cutout (kills the black background box)
throwables: VIP-first tabs, 3-across grid, background-agnostic keying
throwables: enforced 3.5-5s timing, Food tab, sports moves, Card Shark removed

spins: seat-first current_players derived from SEAT rows, in BOTH topUpWithHorses and createOpenSeatTable. Pinned because half of it has already been lost once - the topUpWithHorses branch exists on five branches under five SHAs and was an ancestor of main on none of them, having merged as an explanatory comment while the code under it was flattened away. 16 live Spins advertised 0/3 while holding 32 paid seats as a result. seatFirstCountSync.test.ts guards the shape; this guards the commit. NOTE: pin the SQUASH-MERGE sha from main, not the branch sha - this entry was first written as 38ee27b3d, the pre-merge commit, which is an ancestor of nothing and made this very guard red on the next push.

throwables: voices, impact captions, 30+ per-item signatures. REPINNED 2026-08-23 from db61c77 to the restore commit that actually carries this work on main - db61c77 was orphaned, cherry-picked back under a new SHA, and the entry was never moved. The ancestor test now passes directly instead of leaning on the patch-id fallback, which searches only the last 400 commits: the restore had drifted to 398 and was two commits from disappearing, at which point this guard hard-blocked every push from a fresh worktree.
